mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST above 1200.0) and retail sales (RSAFS above 500,000) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST > 1200.0 and RSAFS > 500,000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE below 3.5%), tight labor markets support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE remains below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS above 149,000) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 149,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS above 3.0%) indicate aggressive inflation-fighting measures that increase corporate financing costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
